target: quarterly retail margin cpg, not all-in
pricing: regional equilibrium spread estimated on earlier weekly observations; separate bounded rise/fall response coefficients with ridge prior 0.35 and penalty 100
hyperparameter_selection: NONE; no scenario selection or retuning after results
weights: same static regional store weights and national weekly demand proxy as weekly V1
boundary: same weekly V1 day weights and final partial-week carry; do not use a future boundary observation
uncertainty: scenario range is sensitivity, not probability calibration; offset variance excludes parameter, proxy and weekly-cost uncertainty
limitations: spot is not delivered acquisition cost
regional retail is not MUSA pump pricing
latent cost and company basis are weakly identified
historical market, demand, weights and outcomes are current-vintage not PIT
hypotheses informed by this same history
partial-quarter disclosures not assimilated in V1
actual publication lags are not reconstructed
